latest.title: Australia seeks feedback on crypto platform rules ahead of 2027 rollout
latest.description: The consultation follows Parliament’s passage of digital asset legislation in April, with Australia’s securities regulator now proposing capital, custody and trading standards for crypto platforms.

latest.title: Nearly $1 billion in crypto bets liquidated as bitcoin, ether and XRP slide
latest.description: Ether accounted for nearly 60% of the forced closures across the two largest cryptocurrencies, falling roughly twice as much as bitcoin.

latest.title: Bitcoin mining pool once handling 2.3% of network shuts after hashrate falls 65%
latest.description: Computing power directed at Binance Pool has fallen from 26 EH/s in December to about 9 EH/s. Its remaining miners must choose another provider before a Nov. 10 cutoff.

latest.title: Elon Musk says Trump is 'ultimately' responsible for any curbs on Ukraine's Starshield systems
latest.description: "Any limits on speed or usage are decided by the US military and ultimately POTUS," Musk wrote.

latest.title: Oil falls as investors assess Mideast tensions, International Energy Agency's report
latest.description: Oil fell Thursday, as traders assessed attacks on ships passing through Hormuz, while digesting the International Energy Agency's latest monthly report.

latest.title: Bitcoin wilts as Fed rate uncertainty weighs. Kospi plunges 8%
latest.description: Bets on an October Fed rate hike briefly spiked to nearly 50% after Wednesday’s inflation report, but have since cooled.

latest.title: Bitcoin miners plunge up to 13% in Wall Street’s worst selloff since July
latest.description: TeraWulf, Core Scientific, Cipher Mining and IREN each lost more than 12% as hotter inflation hit AI infrastructure companies.

latest.title: Meta- and Google-backed Jio Platforms to raise up to $3.2 billion in historic IPO in India
latest.description: Jio's share sale will be India's largest ever in rupee terms, and second largest in dollar terms, trailing the Hyundai Motors IPO that raised $3.3 billion in 2024.

latest.description: The deal gives Polygon access to 37 money transmitter licenses and 11 state exemptions.
